clusters.headline: Broad Support Emerges For Sufmi Dasco Ahmad As Vice President
aiSummaryBullets: Regional Gerindra party chapters across Indonesia are advocating for Sufmi Dasco Ahmad to serve as Vice President.
The NasDem party and labor organizations have officially expressed their support for his potential candidacy.

clusters.headline: President Prabowo Expected To Nominate Vice President By Late November
aiSummaryBullets: President Prabowo Subianto is required to submit two potential vice presidential candidates to the MPR by November 25, 2026.
The MPR has rescheduled the plenary session for the election of the new vice president from December 2 to December 9, 2026.

clusters.headline: President Prabowo Subianto Discusses Regional Priorities At ASEAN
aiSummaryBullets: President Prabowo Subianto urged ASEAN member nations to improve coordination to combat transnational crime.
The Indonesian President advocated for strengthened regional mechanisms to prevent and effectively manage potential crises.

clusters.headline: MPR Sets December 9 For Vice Presidential Election Selection Session
aiSummaryBullets: The MPR has officially scheduled the vice presidential selection and inauguration session for December 9, 2026.
President Prabowo is required to submit two candidates for the position no later than November 25, 2026.

clusters.headline: President Prabowo Urges ASEAN To Intensify Regional Cooperation
aiSummaryBullets: President Prabowo Subianto advocated for enhanced collaboration among ASEAN nations to combat transnational issues including narcotics, cyber fraud, and terrorism.
The Indonesian government is seeking international partnerships to dismantle organized wildlife trafficking networks involving money laundering and document forgery.

clusters.headline: KPK Detains Former Staff Of Anwar Sadad In East Java Grant Case
aiSummaryBullets: The KPK has detained Bagus Wahyudiono, a former staff member of Anwar Sadad, regarding an ongoing corruption case involving provincial grants.
Investigators have seized two properties belonging to the suspect as part of the probe into grant misuse in East Java between 2019 and 2022.

clusters.headline: Indonesian Regional Offices Remove Official Photos Of Gibran Raka
aiSummaryBullets: Government offices in Jakarta and North Sumatra have begun removing official portraits of Gibran Rakabuming Raka.
The removal process follows the vacancy of the Vice Presidential position after Gibran Rakabuming Raka officially resigned.

clusters.headline: Fire Damages Twelve Homes At A Military Housing Complex In Bogor
aiSummaryBullets: A fire destroyed twelve residential properties located at a military housing complex in the Lawanggintung area of Bogor.
Emergency response teams, including firefighters and Brimob water cannon units, contained the blaze after a three-and-a-half-hour effort.

clusters.headline: Mohamad Sohibul Iman Inaugurated As New MPR RI Deputy Chairman
aiSummaryBullets: Mohamad Sohibul Iman officially replaced Hidayat Nur Wahid as Deputy Chairman of the People's Consultative Assembly (MPR) of Indonesia.
The inauguration ceremony for the interim replacement took place at the Parliament Complex in Senayan, Jakarta.

clusters.headline: Badui Tribal Leaders Oppose Proposed Javan Rhino Relocation Plan
aiSummaryBullets: Badui tribal leaders and local officials have expressed formal opposition to moving Javan rhinos from Ujung Kulon.
Concerns center on cultural ancestral messages and potential environmental risks at the proposed secondary habitat in Alas Purwo.

clusters.headline: Indonesian Police Launch Nationwide Zebra Traffic Enforcement Drive
aiSummaryBullets: Regional police units across Indonesia have initiated the two-week Zebra 2026 traffic enforcement campaign.
Authorities are utilizing electronic traffic law enforcement systems alongside manual officer patrols to target specific violations.

clusters.headline: Search Operations Continue For Two Missing Hikers At Mount Semeru
aiSummaryBullets: Two hikers originating from Sidoarjo were reported missing on Mount Semeru amid unstable volcanic conditions.
The mountain experienced multiple volcanic eruptions throughout early November, characterized by ash columns and hot cloud avalanches.

clusters.headline: Government Official Urges Local Leaders To Oversee 2027 Wage Policy
aiSummaryBullets: The Minister of Home Affairs requested regional heads to supervise the 2027 minimum wage determination process.
Labor organizations have requested a 7.5 to 9.5 percent wage increase while rejecting the proposed 0.7 index calculation.

clusters.headline: Polda Metro Jaya Increases Monitoring of Food Supplies Ahead of Nataru
aiSummaryBullets: Polda Metro Jaya is tightening oversight of staple food distribution to prevent price spikes and hoarding.
Cooperation with local government and the National Food Agency is underway to ensure stock availability.

clusters.headline: Diverse Indonesian Institutions Receive Regional Governance Awards
aiSummaryBullets: Regional governments across Indonesia were honored for advancements in digital transformation, public services, and healthcare policies.
Private sector entities received accolades for excellence in medicine distribution standards and advertising effectiveness.

clusters.headline: Indonesian Attorney General Office To Question Bekasi Mayor On KSO
aiSummaryBullets: The Attorney General's Office has summoned the Mayor of Bekasi for questioning.
The examination concerns an ongoing investigation into alleged corruption in operational cooperation management.

clusters.headline: Indonesia National Team Training Camp In Bali Under John Herdman
aiSummaryBullets: Coach John Herdman is evaluating young talent and potential naturalized players during the team's training camp in Bali.
Players like Arlyansyah Abdulmanan have drawn attention for their performance, with prospects of selection for the 2027 SEA Games squad.

clusters.headline: DKI Jakarta Expands Free Education And Proposes Pet Health Coverage
aiSummaryBullets: DPRD DKI Jakarta members propose adding 100 free private schools by 2027, including special needs schools and madrasas, to increase educational access.
Legislators emphasize the need for equitable distribution of the free school program across all Jakarta regions to prevent students from dropping out.

clusters.headline: Indonesia Highlights Food Security And Climate Solutions At COP31
aiSummaryBullets: Indonesia is prioritizing national food security through improved irrigation, increased production, and enhanced risk management.
The government is advocating for the inclusion of maritime issues as a primary agenda item for global climate solutions.

clusters.headline: Muhammadiyah Discusses Economic Policy And Governance At Milad 114
aiSummaryBullets: Muhammadiyah officials expressed support for government initiatives aimed at reforming the management of national natural resources.
The organization addressed concerns regarding economic oligarchy and its potential impact on social justice and collective unity.
